name: Blood-Crazed (S-Class Veritus Champion Sanguine Bond)
body:
The blood-crazed are veritus champions who internalize their gifts, using their blood debt to empower themselves, becoming even stronger the more they devote.

Infuse Blood (Su)

At 4th level, a blood-crazed veritus champion discovers how to infuse his blood debt back into himself, altering his body’s natural chemistry. As a standard action, he converts 12 points of his blood debt and selects one physical ability score—either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. This causes the champion to grow bulkier and more bestial, granting him a +2 natural armor bonus and a +4 alchemical bonus to the selected ability score for 10 minutes per veritus champion level. In addition, while his blood is infused, the champion takes a –2 penalty to one of his mental ability scores. If the he enhanced his Strength, it applies a penalty to his Intelligence. If he enhances his Dexterity, it applies a penalty to his Wisdom. If he enhances his Constitution, it applies a penalty to his Charisma.

The effects of infuse blood do not stack with itself or similar abilities, such as the alchemist’s mutagen. Whenever a blood-crazed veritus champion infuses his blood again, the effects of any previous, similar effect immediately end.

Beginning at 14th level, infuse blood lasts for 1 hour per veritus champion level instead.

This ability replaces blood magic and blood possession.

Improved Infuse Blood: At 12th level, the champion’s infused blood now grants him a +4 natural armor bonus, a +6 alchemical bonus to one physical ability score (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), and a +4 alchemical bonus to a second physical ability score. The champion takes a –2 penalty on both associated mental ability scores as long as infuse blood persists.

Greater Infused Blood: At 16th level, the champion’s infused blood now grants him a +6 natural armor bonus, a +8 alchemical bonus to one ability score (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution), a +6 alchemical bonus to a second physical ability score, and a +4 alchemical bonus to a third physical ability score. The champion takes a –2 penalty to all three mental ability scores as long as infuse blood persists.

Superior Infused Blood: At 20th level, the champion’s infused blood now grants a +8 natural armor bonus and a +8 alchemical bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. He takes a –2 penalty to all three mental ability scores as long as infuse blood persists.

Discoveries

At 6th level, and again at 10th level, a blood-crazed veritus champion gains either a bomb discovery or a mutagen discovery, as an alchemist of his veritus champion level. Bomb discoveries are applied to the champion’s blood burst ability, and mutagen discoveries are applied when he uses infuse blood.

This replaces waves of blood.

Sanguine Jump (Sp)

At 18th level, a blood-crazed veritus champion can use his sanguine step to teleport, as greater teleport. This alters the level at which the veritus champion gains this ability.
